calls.reason: Price wars and hallucinations held, but OpenAI expected a roughly $5B 2024 loss rather than modest profits, and a third-party reviewer disputes the 'no massive advance' and moat items. Three items have no evidence at all.

CNBC reported an expected roughly $5B 2024 loss. Coverage of documents obtained by The Information said OpenAI projected losses through 2028 and no profit until 2029, matching both parts of the claim.

Reuters and TIME confirm that slowdown reports existed, but TIME calls the picture mixed, Anthropic denied any deviation from scaling laws, and o1 showed large reasoning gains. No multi-measure comparison exists.

A 2024 study found critical generalization shortcomings in state-of-the-art planners, and a 2024 Waymo recall followed an unusual pole collision. Waymo's strong aggregate safety record does not show edge cases were solved.
Bloomberg-sourced reports say Orion's jump was smaller than GPT-4's, but o1 went from 12% to 74% on AIME over GPT-4o. With old benchmarks saturated, the evidence is mixed.

No matched predicted-versus-observed training results were found. Reuters reports concerns only, and Llama 3 in mid-2024 reported scaling predictions that held, so the evidence does not show the laws stopped predicting.
